patthana23.24:1.1: dhammaṃ paccayā savitakkasavicāro kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā paṇṇarasa,
patthana23.24:2.1: na savitakkasavicāraṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā savitakkasavicāro akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā nava,
patthana23.24:3.1: savitakkasavicāraṃ na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakkaavicāro abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā satta, na pītisahagataṃ na kusalaṃ
